spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (स्खदते)
1 To defeat, to discomfit.
2 To cut.
3 To make firm.
4 To destroy, to hurt or kill.
5 To fatigue, to exhaust.
6 To eat, to taste.

n. (-नं)
1 Defeating, discomfiting.
2 Injury, hurting, killing.
E.
स्खद to defeat, aff. ल्युट्.

r. 1st cl. (स्खलति)
1 To move, to go.
2 To slip, to stumble or fall.
3 To gather, to collect.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
Stumbling, tripping, (either in motion, conduct, or speech.)
E.
स्खल to stumble, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
Blundering, making mistakes in speaking.
E.
स्खलत्, and वाक्य speech.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Erring in judgment, foolish.
E.
स्खलत्, and मति understanding.

n. (-नं)
1 Stumbling, slipping, tripping.
2 Stumbling or falling from virtue.
3 Tripping in speech, making a mistake or blunder in speech or pronunciation.
4 Knocking or falling together, shock, collision.
5 Striking or rubbing one thing against another.
E.
स्खल to go, to drop, aff. ल्युट्.

Shaken, agitated, disturbed.
4 Shaking, wavering, unsteady, (literally or figuratively.)
5

Stuttering, hesitating, (in speech.)
n. (-तं)
1 Circumvention, stratagem, (in war.)
2 Falling, tumbling.
3 Falling or deviating from virtue or truth.
E.
स्खल to go, aff. क्त.
